name: fmp_sector_performance
description:
Sector performance snapshot from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/sector-performance): percentage change by market sector (Technology, Healthcare, Financial Services and others).
Returns {sectors}: FMP's list of sector records.
Inputs (* required): none.
For individual stocks use fmp_market_gainers, fmp_market_losers or fmp_most_active; for sector names fmp_available_sectors.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {}
